criteria.reason: Simple vocabulary, rulebook and class-vote analogies, short sentences; well suited to a 10-year-old.
Omits both required facts: no 100,000-signature figure and no 18-month deadline anywhere.
Three numbered steps, bold headers, engaging analogies; reasonably short despite opening fluff.

summary: Warm, child-friendly explanation of the popular initiative process, but it omits the required 100,000-signature threshold and 18-month deadline.
